body: Using `inline` function probably would be more readable.
I'm worried about performance penalties for inline causes, as the compiler does not guarantee the function will be inlined?
It's not guaranteed, but should not be a performance issue.
Okay, I will change that back to the inline function call.

I'm having trouble converting the MACRO to an inline function; the main blocker is passing vararg parameters pack into the function pointer that contains vararg:

Instead of hard-coding defaults, you should create an instance of `StackedOutlineData` and use its properties. See here for example:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4e6451d62a931a664acabbf3967e2874fedaadcd/scene/gui/file_dialog.cpp#L1612-L1616
